data.name: Subtitle
data.value: Explore available items, quantities and item details.

data.name: ContextHelp
data.value: Use the public inventory context supplied by the game.

data.name: Search
data.value: Search name, type, AssetID or ClassID

data.name: SelectHint
data.value: Select an item to see its available details.

data.name: MetadataMissing
data.value: Steam did not return a matching item description. Name, type and trade flags are unknown.

data.name: Partial
data.value: Incomplete inventory: {0} Loaded items remain available. Global totals are N/A.

data.name: InterruptedFailed
data.value: Further pages could not be loaded.

data.name: Idle
data.value: Open a profile, then choose an inventory to load.

data.name: NotLoaded
data.value: Choose an inventory and select Load inventory.

data.name: InvalidContext
data.value: Enter a positive numeric context ID without spaces or leading zeros.

data.name: Cancelled
data.value: Inventory loading was cancelled. Select Load inventory to try again.

data.name: Private
data.value: Steam explicitly reported this inventory as private.

data.name: RateLimited
data.value: Steam is limiting inventory requests. Please try again later.

data.name: Failed
data.value: The inventory could not be loaded. Please try again.

data.name: MissingKey
data.value: A Steam API key is required. Configure GAMEPULSE_STEAM_API_KEY in your local .env or environment, then restart the app.

data.name: Unavailable
data.value: This inventory is unavailable. Steam may restrict access or the selected context may not be available.

data.name: PartialReady
data.value: Some inventory pages are available. Check the completeness note below.

data.name: FilterFailed
data.value: The item filter could not be applied. Please reset the filters.

data.name: ClipboardFailed
data.value: The AssetID could not be copied.

data.name: ExternalFailed
data.value: The Steam inventory could not be opened.

data.name: CompleteNote
data.value: Quantities include each asset’s amount. Trade and market flags are shown only when Steam supplies them.

data.name: StopPageLimit
data.value: The configured local page safety limit was reached.

data.name: StopSizeLimit
data.value: The configured local size safety limit was reached.

data.name: StopSourceChanged
data.value: Steam returned inconsistent inventory counts during loading; refresh to check the current inventory.

data.name: StopInvalidPagination
data.value: Steam returned inconsistent pagination or repeated items; refresh before interpreting totals.

data.name: StopMissingTotal
data.value: Steam did not supply an inventory total, so completeness cannot be confirmed.
